FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 242
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Phillip Rigsby
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/20/2025
House Bill 242 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Medicaid Agency
by an agency-estimated minimum of $4.5 million annually ($3.3 million in federal funds and
$1.2 million in state funds) by providing coverage for rapid genome sequencing for certain
individuals.
